description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for managing and summarizing queues, including handling queue state, drop policies, debouncing, and cross-channel item detection.

methods.name: clearQueueSummaryState
methods.description: Resets the dropped count and summary lines in the queue summary state.

methods.name: previewQueueSummaryPrompt
methods.description: Builds a prompt string summarizing the queue state for display.

methods.name: applyQueueRuntimeSettings
methods.description: Applies runtime configuration settings to a queue, such as mode, debounce, cap, and drop policy.

methods.name: elideQueueText
methods.description: Truncates text to a specified limit, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: buildQueueSummaryLine
methods.description: Creates a summarized line of queue text, cleaning and truncating it.

methods.name: shouldSkipQueueItem
methods.description: Determines whether a queue item should be skipped based on a deduplication function.

methods.name: applyQueueDropPolicy
methods.description: Enforces the drop policy on a queue, possibly removing items and updating summary lines.

methods.name: waitForQueueDebounce
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after the debounce period has elapsed.

methods.name: beginQueueDrain
methods.description: Marks a queue as draining and returns it if not already draining.

methods.name: drainNextQueueItem
methods.description: Processes the next item in the queue asynchronously.

methods.name: drainCollectItemIfNeeded
methods.description: Decides whether to drain an item based on cross-channel and force collection flags.

methods.name: drainCollectQueueStep
methods.description: Performs a step in draining the queue, updating collection state accordingly.

methods.name: buildQueueSummaryPrompt
methods.description: Generates a textual summary prompt for the queue overflow, including dropped items.

methods.name: buildCollectPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a prompt listing collected items with optional summary.

methods.name: hasCrossChannelItems
methods.description: Checks if any items in a list are cross-channel based on a resolver function.
